enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Deception +5: +5 Insight bonus to hit and +8 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Quality Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Insightful Assassinate +6: +6 Insight bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Use Magic Device +5: Passive: +5 Competence bonus to the Use Magic Device skill.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
